title: FAA Flight Instructor Airplane and Fundamentals of Instructing
releaseBlockers: eight sets were budgeted at one card each: recount before release
description: Flight Instructor: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: the Aviation Instructor's Handbook, the FAA handbooks, ACS and 14 CFR
notice: Contains material from 14 CFR part 61, the FAA Flight Instructor for Airplane Category Airman Certification Standards, the Aviation Instructor's Handbook, the Airplane Flying Handbook, the Instrument Flying Handbook and Advisory Circular 61-65K, which are US Government works in the public domain. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the Federal Aviation Administration or the U.S. Department of Transportation. The Flight Instructor Airplane (FIA) and Fundamentals of Instructing (FOI) knowledge tests are FAA tests.

checks.what: Three independent audits read all 1197 cards against the FAA sources they quote (Aviation Instructor's Handbook, Airplane Flying Handbook, the flight instructor ACS, AC 61-65K and 14 CFR 61), found word for word by the card checker, including every figure
checks.result: One wrong card (a transfer-of-learning rule that named the wrong skill) fixed; one card with several right answers and 7 other ambiguous cards rewritten; 2 unsupported claims and 7 unclear cards fixed; 18 duplicates deleted, 15 of them where the three topic 9 writers overlapped. Seven primers that re-teach private pilot terms (risk, PAVE, IMSAFE, 3P, situational awareness, SRM, 5P) were kept on purpose.
